summary: Iter52 — backend + frontend verification ALL GREEN. New harness /app/backend/tests/test_iter52_features.py covers 17 tests in ~14s: (a) core/webhooks send_slack_webhook + send_discord_webhook + notify_hot_lead return False/{slack:false,discord:false} gracefully without SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL/DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL — verified via direct import with sys.path injection; (b) POST /api/landing-chatbot/score-session correctly APPENDS a new row to landing_lead_score_history on every call (immutable timeline, not upsert) — verified count increments from N → N+1 on repeated rescore; GET /score-history/{session_id} and GET /leads/score-history-by-email/{email} return sorted history; non-admin → 403; (c) full funnel e2e: 5-turn chat → /leads POST → /score-session → /sales-invite → /funnel/track stage=sales_call_accepted exercises all 5 funnel stages; GET /analytics/funnel returns correct shape (funnel array w/ stage/count/from_top_pct/from_prev_pct + hot_leads_total + hot_alerts_sent) and all 5 stages show count>=1 after e2e; invalid stage → 400; non-admin → 403; (d) LiveKit Egress start returns {egress_id, status:'mock', note:'LIVEKIT_URL/API_KEY not configured — egress mocked'} without real keys; /egress list works; /egress/{id}/stop returns {ok:true}; user-session trying to stop admin's egress → 403; (e) hot-lead metadata: scored lead (score>=80) has hot_alert_sent_at + hot_alert_channels fields populated. iter51 regression (sales-invite email_reason contract, CSV export, /analytics base) + iter50/iter48/iter46 (35 tests) ALL PASS. Frontend /admin/landing-leads Playwright verified: data-testid='admin-leads-funnel' renders above the chart with all 5 bars (admin-funnel-stage-chat_started ... sales_call_accepted), live counts 8/3/4/8/3, 'Hot leads: 7 · Alerts gesendet: 4'; per-lead Rescore (admin-lead-rescore-0) + History (admin-lead-history-0) buttons present; clicking History opens admin-history-modal titled 'Score-Historie' and fires GET /api/landing-chatbot/leads/score-history-by-email/<email> (200); clicking Rescore triggers /score-session (verified via network intercept in backend tests — frontend intercept in this run was on per-email history endpoint).

issues: from_prev_pct rendering shows >100% (133.3% for email_captured, 200% for sales_call_sent) because legacy rows in landing_funnel_events + landing_leads pre-date the chat_started tracking — raw counts are correct but ratio confuses at first glance. Cosmetic only; the _score_session_lead/funnel backend logic clamps/computes correctly for fresh sessions. Consider clamping from_prev_pct to min(100, …) in UI OR backfilling legacy sessions with a synthetic chat_started event.

action_items: Cosmetic: clamp from_prev_pct display to <=100% in AdminLandingLeadsPage Lead-Funnel bars (optional — counts remain accurate).

Test warning: TestLiveKitEgress.test_egress_start_returns_mock_status has an accidental `return d['egress_id']` that triggers PytestReturnNotNoneWarning — safe to remove (test still passes). Low priority.

Onboarding overlay re-appears for fresh browser contexts and /login URL renders home page when onboarding isn't dismissed — frontend testers must click 'Überspringen' then 'Anmelden' to reach login form. Non-blocking but minor UX friction.
critical_code_review_comments: landing_chatbot.py /funnel/track is PUBLIC (no auth) — expected per spec so frontend can track sales_call_accepted. Currently accepts arbitrary session_id/email from anyone and writes to landing_funnel_events. Consider rate-limiting or at least verifying session_id exists in landing_chat_sessions to prevent funnel-spam from bots.

landing_chatbot.py get_funnel_analytics computes from_prev_pct using a sticky `prev_count` that only updates when c>0 — this causes ratio >100% when a downstream stage has more events than an upstream one (e.g. legacy sales_call_sent events with no chat_started). Functional but misleading; consider using strict prev stage count (even if 0) or filter events to those with a corresponding chat_started.

livekit_streaming.py start_egress_recording: when the real client fails (egress_error set), record['status'] is still 'started' from the initial assignment but the response returns status='mock'/'started' from the route — actual value depends on whether LIVEKIT_URL is set. Should ensure DB record reflects same status as response for observability. Minor.

core/webhooks.py notify_hot_lead: return type is dict with slack/discord booleans. The caller in _score_session_lead iterates `result.items()` expecting all values to be bools — if send_slack_webhook/send_discord_webhook ever returns a non-bool (e.g. raises before return-value), [k for k,v in result.items() if v] would crash. Current code is safe (both helpers have try/except returning False), but worth adding `isinstance(v, bool)` guard.

Existing test files test_iter46_livekit_hardware.py, test_iter48_p2_cleanup.py crash at collection if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var is unset (use `os.environ.get(...).rstrip('/')` without default). They work when the var is exported (CI-safe) but fail on a bare `pytest` invocation. Cosmetic — iter52 file uses fallback default for robustness.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on /admin/landing-leads — funnel section + 5 stage bars + rescore/history buttons + history modal verified via Playwright
